introHtml: Poly propylene is a lightweight yet durable material ideal for banners, mats, and signs that need to withstand weather without fading. Unlike vinyl, it resists tearing and can be printed with vibrant graphics. Perfect for trade show displays, outdoor event signage, or floor mats that require non-slip backing. Choose poly propylene for a cost-effective solution that holds up to heavy foot traffic or repeated use.
